name: @shakuf-widget/widget
description: כלי עזר נגישות לאתרים ישראליים — תוסף צד-לקוח, ללא שרת וללא איסוף מידע. אינו מבטיח עמידה בת״י 5568 ואינו תחליף להנגשת האתר.
//publishConfig: Scoped packages default to restricted, which needs a paid plan. Public is required for jsDelivr/unpkg to serve it at all.
//files: Sourcemaps ARE published. They were excluded while the repo was private, because tsup embeds sourcesContent and that would have put the whole TypeScript source on npm; the repo went public on 2026-08-13, so that reason is gone. Both bundles carry a sourceMappingURL, so excluding the maps made every installer's devtools request 404 against the CDN. Visitors pay nothing: a browser fetches a .map only with devtools open, and the size budget in scripts/size.mjs measures shakuf.js alone.

scripts.//prepack: npm requires these beside package.json to include them in the tarball. Copied at pack time rather than committed, so the published copies can never drift from the originals at the repo root.
